from_notes: Ayurveda Day: Observed annually on 23 September from 2025; earlier observed on Dhanteras.
from_notes_src: octlatest daily EM CA 19 Oct 2026 p.5
x: The Ministry of Ayush fixed Ayurveda Day on 23 September (the autumnal equinox) from 2025; earlier it moved with Dhanteras (Dhanvantari Jayanti). 23 June/July/August are not linked to it; Yoga Day is the summer solstice, 21 June.
source: octlatest daily EM CA 19 Oct 2026 p.5; octlatest daily EM CA 21 Oct 2026 p.7 ('Since 2025, Ayurveda Day has been observed annually on 23 September'); app notes 6:104 sub 0

x: The 2022 World Space Week (4–10 October, declared by the UNGA in 1999) had the theme "Space and Sustainability". "Women in Space" was the 2021 theme and "Satellites Improve Life" the 2020 theme, so only one option fits. The 2026 theme is "The Rocket Revolution".
source: unoosa.org World Space Week 2022 webinar series 'Space and Sustainability' (web search result, UNOOSA pages); Rocket CA 2026 Part 02 p.97, p.119 (WSW 4–10 Oct, 2026 theme 'Rocket Revolution'); 2021/2020 themes: general knowledge, not checked
evidence: Local library: Rocket CA 2026 has only the 2026 theme
web search 'World Space Week 2022 theme Space and Sustainability UNOOSA' (unoosa.org, worldspaceweek.org agree)

x: Indian current-affairs sources give the 2025 World Humanitarian Day (19 August) theme as "Strengthening Global Solidarity and Empowering Local Communities"; the other options are generic slogans of no 19 August observance. The UN/OCHA campaign itself ran under the hashtag #ActForHumanity.
dispute: Most CA books / exam keys: "Strengthening Global Solidarity and Empowering Local Communities". Strictly: the UN's own 2025 campaign was #ActForHumanity and UN pages do not use that phrase (ungeneva.org WHD 2025 page).
source: bizzbuzz.news WHD 2025 article (fetched: theme 'Strengthening Global Solidarity and Empowering Local Communities'); ungeneva.org/en/meetings-events/events/observances-special-events/2025/08/world-humanitarian-day-2025 (fetched: #ActForHumanity); Praveen CA-360 Aug 2026 one-liners p.24 (UN/OCHA since 2009, #ActForHumanity)
evidence: Local library: no 2025 theme; Rocket Disaster Mgmt p.50 has only the date (19 Aug, UN)
web search: adda247, pwonlyias give the printed theme; UN Indonesia, UN Geneva give #ActForHumanity

from_notes: The 77th Van Mahotsav was observed from July 1 to July 7, 2026, to promote tree planting and environmental protection. The initiative was started in 1950 by K. M. Munshi.
x: Van Mahotsav, the tree-planting festival started in 1950 by K.M. Munshi, is held in the first week of July (1–7 July; 77th edition in 2026), at the onset of the monsoon.
source: Praveen CA-360 Jul 2026 magazine p.18; app notes 6:105 sub 1 (1–7 July, 77th)

from_notes: Public Service Broadcasting Day – 12 November; marks Gandhi's only visit to the AIR studio, Delhi, 1947 (addressed Partition refugees).
x: Public Service Broadcasting Day (Jan Prasaran Diwas, declared 2000) is on 12 November: on 12 November 1947 Gandhi made his only visit to All India Radio, at Broadcasting House, Delhi (not Bombay), and addressed Partition refugees at the Kurukshetra camp.
source: mkgandhi.org/newannou/gandhi_AIR.html (fetched: 12 Nov 1947, AIR Broadcasting House, Parliament Street, Delhi; Kurukshetra refugees; day declared in 2000); app notes 6:105 sub 3
evidence: old explanation said 'All India Radio station in Bombay' – contradicts the notes (Delhi)
web search 'Public Service Broadcasting Day 12 November Gandhi AIR 1947' (ABU, IIC Delhi, Prasar Bharati results: New Delhi)

from_notes: United Nations declared 21 June as International Yoga Day on 11 December 2014.
x: International Yoga Day is on 21 June (summer solstice), declared by the UN on 11 December 2014 and first observed in 2015; the 12th edition (2026) was themed "Yoga for Healthy Ageing" with the main event in Kolkata.
